description: Confirmation set measured once, after the statement-page rules were final. These metrics and pages were not used to write or revise any rule or label: operating income on four filings and research and development expense on two. Its purpose is to check the held-out set's 8/8 was not itself fitted. The 3M FY2018 case also exercises the extracted heading 'Consolidated Statement of Incom e', where extraction inserted a space inside the word.
